fronts.name: temporal-binding-policy
fronts.notes: Requires exact canonical v10 result identity, evidenceComplete=true, non-authoritative SHADOW_MATCH with all comparison booleans true, exact same-observation canonical witness identity, exact witness-to-surgery path-set parity, and later portable/descriptor parity.

fronts.name: temporal-binding-regression
fronts.notes: Pins missing witness, canonical-result mismatch, canonical wound, non-admitted shadow comparison, future exact binding, later content divergence, duplicate/phantom/malformed witness evidence.

fronts.name: owner-boundary
fronts.notes: Canonical Surgery lacks retained same-observation byte/SHA fields and classify lacks artifactContentWitnesses; descriptor shadow lacks temporal-policy consumption.

fronts.name: touchable-source
fronts.notes: Non-raster radio/keyboard Warm Wall distinguishes result identity, missing canonical witness, later-read agreement, future bound state, divergence, and RED owner boundary without runtime or phone claims.

corrections: Initial temporal policy could have bound matching artifact arrays without requiring an admitted SHADOW_MATCH; fixed by exact status + three-boolean gate.
Initial temporal policy did not require canonical witness path set to equal canonical Surgery path set; fixed fail-closed.

Initial RED owner fixture required a literal artifactContentWitnesses string and could reject a correct constant-based implementation; fixed to accept direct literal or WITNESS_FIELD usage while remaining RED today.
